welcomePage.heading: The Chatbot
welcomePage.subtitle: Your personal assistant on the web and WhatsApp.
welcomePage.description: A personal workspace for conversations, tasks, notes, cash flow and monthly bills. Pick an area below, or just ask in chat.

chat.title: AI Chat
chat.description: Talk by text or voice, switch AI models, and let the assistant work across your personal tools.

todos.title: Todos
todos.description: Capture tasks from chat or the web, add due dates, filter the queue, and track completion.

notes.title: Markdown Notes
notes.description: Keep lasting notes in portable Markdown and refine drafts with AI before you save.

artifacts.title: HTML Artifacts
artifacts.description: Publish rich, self-contained pages with layouts, inline SVG, highlighted code, and shareable links.

cashFlow.title: Cash Flow
cashFlow.description: Review balances and transactions, add entries, and sync your real bank balance with Google Sheets.

bills.title: Monthly Bills
bills.description: Maintain a recurring monthly checklist, follow payment progress, and preserve payment history.

welcomePage.footerPrompt: Choose a workspace to get started

thankYouPage.subtitle: You are all set
thankYouPage.body: The assistant can now use your Google account with your spreadsheets. Head back to WhatsApp or open the web app.
thankYouPage.footerPrompt: You can also close this window and return to WhatsApp.
